tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings, values and body copy on bg-canvas, bg-surface and bg-surface-raised. Contrast — dark: bg-canvas 17.1:1, bg-surface 14.0:1, bg-surface-raised 9.5:1; light: bg-canvas 18.3:1, bg-surface 17.1:1, bg-surface-raised 18.3:1.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, labels (.vz-label), table cells, inactive nav items. Contrast — dark: bg-canvas 11.0:1, bg-surface 9.0:1, bg-surface-raised 6.1:1; light: bg-canvas 6.6:1, bg-surface 6.1:1, bg-surface-raised 6.6:1.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Metadata, placeholders, helper text (.vz-help), table headers, icons in nav. Light: neutral-600 (≈4.35:1 on bg-canvas, 4.05:1 on bg-surface — adjusted from neutral-500 for contrast; neutral-700 would merge with text-secondary). Dark: neutral-400 (8.5:1 canvas, 6.9:1 surface, 4.7:1 raised).

tokens.name: text-on-cta

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Inline links and .vz-btn--link. Contrast — dark: bg-canvas 7.5:1, bg-surface 6.1:1, bg-surface-raised 4.2:1; light: bg-canvas 6.9:1, bg-surface 6.4:1, bg-surface-raised 6.9:1. Dark: ≈4.2:1 on bg-surface-raised — prefer links on canvas/surface in dark.
